name: Beri
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Beri is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Shobal, in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher. He is known only from this single genealogical reference, and little else is known about his life or deeds. His significance lies in his place in the tribal history of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Beri is mentioned as one of the sons of Shobal in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: The genealogy of the tribe of Asher was recorded to document the leadership and family lines of the tribe, with Beri included as part of this historical overview.
